launches.title: Constor: The AI-native OS for construction
launches.tagline: AI takeoffs from your drawings in minutes per project instead of weeks
launches.body:
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E3K_b6wc3mY>

### **What we're building**

We're building Constor, the AI-native OS for construction, starting with takeoffs and estimates for subcontractors and general contractors. Projects that take days to measure and count by hand can be analyzed in a few minutes, giving estimators quantities to review and price using the right rates.

![Reviewing construction plans](https://constor.ai/launch/constor-plan-review.jpg)

### **The team**

Louis was born into a family that ran an hvac business. He watched his dad get up early and spend hours measuring drawings and preparing estimates, then started helping with the takeoffs himself in middle school. Last spring, Louis, Elio (ex-researcher @ ETH) and Dany (ex-Adobe sales) met at a hacker house in San Francisco they started. A dinner conversation turned into Constor, giving contractors their time back to focus on what matters most: building.

![Image](https://constor.ai/launch/constor-yc-launch.jpg)

### **What we've learned**

Growing up in the industry and working with contractors taught us that drawings are only part of the job. Plans contain errors, specifications leave things out, and experienced estimators rely on unwritten knowledge to make sense of both.

They still spend about an hour per drawing measuring and counting by hand. A 50-drawing project can take around 50 hours before the work is even priced. Constor brings drawings, specifications, quantities and pricing into a streamlined workflow.

### **How it works**

* Upload the project's drawings and specifications.
* Constor identifies, measures and counts the elements.
* Review the quantities against the plans, make adjustments, and Constor connects to the right price sources to build an estimate.

### **Where we're going**

We start with takeoffs and estimating, then expand into the entire construction workflow. Subcontractors will prepare and submit bids through Constor, general contractors will compare offers and coordinate blueprint revisions, and suppliers will provide current pricing and fulfill orders. Our ambition is to make Constor the shared workspace where construction projects are priced, awarded, procured and managed.

### **Try Constor on your project**

If you're a subcontractor or general contractor estimating from drawings, email [founders@constor.ai](mailto:founders@constor.ai) for a demo or book \[here\](<https://constor.ai/landing/en/book>). We'd also appreciate introductions to estimators and construction business owners.
